body.question: Does a learned channel estimator actually beat LMMSE at low SNR?

in_scope: Rayleigh tap channels with exponential power-delay profile
seed-matched paired comparison against a scalar-Wiener LMMSE baseline

constraints: the whole run must reproduce in under a minute
success_criteria: every reported gain carries a 95 percent interval from matched seeds
the baseline is stated explicitly and is not straw
the SNR sweep spans both sides of 0 dB
